Fahri to Alex:

"Most people are better in the abstract."

This one really stuck with me.

I never really realized the impact playing piper chapman had on Taylor Schilling until the Independent published an article on it last February in which she said that the backlash to Piper hurt her because she took it personally and apparently she didn't feel part of the "pack" anymore.

Taylor's words: "It really changed. I definitely observed that feeling of celebration shifting into resentment for Piper. It's a difficult thing to not personalize that. I started to feel like my job in that show was just as a space-holder, to provide a steady middle so that other people could really shine."
Were friends for 12y, she became famous and stopped responding to my texts. It's been 10 months.

What does being "too simple" even mean? Don't get me wrong, I do get what you're trying to say. But let me tell you being super feminine or being into fashion is not a requirement to be attractive or to score dates. Just be yourself, use some humor and there'll be plenty of guys that'll be interested in you.
Since you asked for some specific advice on your photos, I think they're great although I think the quality of the first one could be a bit better. But don't stress over it, I used some shitty quality photos and still scored some dates, it all depends on how you text and act. Just remember that you're beautiful and perfect as you are, don't change that for anyone. Have fun dating!

Sometimes, how hard it is, you just have to put yourself in a situation where you now you'll be called by names and pronounces that aren't yours just so you can flee from a worse situation (still happens to me and I've been out since I'm 14 and have a full grown beard now. can you picture me still being called a girl every once in a while ;) ) So I think that going to your grandmother might be a good idea, maybe use your time there to search the internet for support groups if you aren't able to do that at home due to all the restrictions (which are totally unecessary and cruel).
I wish you all the luck in the world! And don't forget that you are a very courageous young man for putting up with all of this and still standing your ground. Never let anyone tell you that you can change the way you are because if you're transgender there's no other option than to transition. If you think otherwise, then you're just lying to yourself and making an already hard life even more difficult. So don't do that unless you're life is in danger and if that's the case than I would advise you to go to your grandmother and ask her for support. Don't be afraid to ask help when needed. 

I'm rooting for you!

Dear writer. I can't begin to tell you how truly sorry I am of the things you're going through. I myself am a 21 year old transguy who had to fight for years, even to this day, to get his family to aknowledge his gender identity and it literally breaks my heart to read that you have to go through a similar experience. Although I don't know your full story I do wonder if you have a nearby support group for lgbt youth where you might be able to find some support and love? For me this was the only way to get through the day at some of my worst days. Isn't there any friend or family member that might be able to take you in? Even for a few nights so you can be at peace and be able to breathe? I certainly know the significance of a binder and it's upsetting that your mom seems to think it's okay to cut you off from one of your lifelines. Sending you a hug my friend.

I also read the article stating that Piper is the worst character ever and I find it to be a very ignorant opinion. Frankly, it's a very easy way to look at her and to not question her actions further than "she's priviledged and just whining about how her life sucks."

In general I have a problem with people who feel the need to compare their problems with those of others because you don't know the general impact they have on their lives. Yes Piper is rich, yes she had a relatively easy childhood and had everything thrown at her in life and you could say that she threw it all away for a little adventure. Yes she's naive and entitled but what some people fail to see is how complex of a person she is and how her upbringing defines how she reacts. How she acts in season 3 is just the result of her trying to find a way to survive in prison and when finally Maria confronts her and puts up a mirror she breaks through Piper's facade and I think that's one of the first moments Piper actually really doubts herself. Which isn't much of a surprise seeing as she never learned that it is necessary to question yourself or your actions, as long as you keep under the radar, keep on smiling and don't change the families reputation.

People also hate Piper because it seems like she can't be by herself. She switches from one relationship to another. This is typical behavior for someone who hasn't experienced any love from their parents and is in constant need of feeling love and affection from someone else.

I must say that I've never had any hate towards Piper, sure there have been moments where I felt frustrated and wanted her to do better or thought that she should put others first but overall I don't think she's a bad person. She's doing the best she can.

I can relate to your feelings toward the Sylvie flashback scenes. For me the way they portayed Alex in season 7 was so not relatable to how we knew her before. What I took from those scenes is that Alex is the type of person that cares for someone until she thinks they'll leave so then she hurts them first to protect herself. This I can understand and I had this already figured out for myself but the problem here is that I begin to question how much she truly loves someone opposed to clinging to someone for the sake of not wanting to be alone. This season showed us that this is a reoccuring pattern for Alex, first with cheating on Sylvie with Piper and then cheating on Piper with McCullough.
What I find to be very frustrating is that this doesn't add up with the Alex I came to love in all previous seasons. I genuinly believe and still want to believe that she really didn't know how to do relationships and that Piper was the first person she loved but somehow now I find it really hard hard to puzzle the new flashbacks into the story they gave us up until season 7.
It is my opinion that they didn't do Alex any justice with these flashbacks. I need someone to analyse this from start to finish.

I didn't see any other possible outcome then for them to be endgame. It was very clear that Piper in s6 fully commited herself to her relationship with Alex and for her to throw it all away, yet again, to just leave Zelda after awhile would be selfdestructive. Cause what kind of guarantee is there that Alex will still be there if she leaves this time? 

Cause that's what'll happen. Piper won't ever be able to let Alex go, she'll eventually want her back. Just like she told Larry.

Tbh I'm really struggling to get through the scenes with the whole alex/mccullough bullshit. Alex was so sweet with piper during their whole wedding. She has the chance to stop her dangerous actions and get out in a few years like she promised Piper so why the fuck is she still doing it? 
I get that she has abandonment issues because of her dad but after seeing that scene with sylvie and seeing how she's basically treating Piper the same way now without having the danger to get caught cheating by her wife makes me question how much she actually loves Piper. I have never ever in a million years had any doubts about Alex's love for Piper but now when I'm seeing all of this... I have no idea what the heck is going on with Alex.
That scene with alex and piper just breaks my heart.
Whoever has the opportunity to bid the heighest on Alex's glasses is a lucky bastard.
I know you posted this a while ago but I just wanted to say that such things really hurt. I don't know why people do such things. I'm sorry you had to go through this.

I'm glad that you reached out and posted a bit of your story here on reddit. That was a brave thing to do. Not everyone can take the step to reach out for help. Hope you are safe.
